notes.title: Release Update: New Target Date – September 30
notes.notes: [p][i]The Tale of Relm[/i] is currently in review with Steam. While that’s a big step forward, it means the game won’t release today.[/p][p]Once the review is complete, I’ll still need to run final tests on the Steam build. Because Steam only allows you to change your release date once, I’ve chosen [b]September 30[/b] as the new target date to be sure everything is ready and working properly.[/p][p]Thanks for bearing with me — we’re almost there![/p]

notes.title: Almost There – A First Look at the Box & Manual!
notes.notes: [p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taleofrelm/the-tale-of-relm-0/posts"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taleofrelm/the-tale-of-relm-0/posts[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We’re now in the final stretch of The Tale of Relm! The game itself is nearly finished, and I’ve started production prep for the physical editions — including the box, printed manual, Map etc.[/p][p]Today, I'm excited to give you a look at some of those physical elements being created:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193956/879946cbedbb5867fc7c10926f59155730800599.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193956/dd052d1d3ebd063a4652cd3e55dd3d484149d589.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These pieces have been designed with the same care and tone as the game itself — to feel like they belong in the world of Relm. [/p][p]🎯 Limited Pledge Tiers Reopened[/p][p]To finalize our production numbers, we’ve reopened two Physical pledge tiers on Kickstarter: [/p][list][*][p]Boxed Edition [/p][/*][*][p]Royal Edition [/p][/*][/list][p]Once we lock in the quantities for manufacturing, these tiers will close for good. So if you’ve been waiting — or know someone who missed the campaign — now’s the time.[/p][p]🙌 Thank You & Spread the Word[/p][p]Your support has brought this game to life. We're almost at the finish line, and I can’t wait to ship the final experience to you.[/p][p]Please feel free to share this post with others who might want to be part of it before it wraps up. The next update will include some final game polish and production progress![/p]
